title: Route dataset acquisition and preserve canonical literature
description: Routes experiment data preparation through dataset-acquisition and requires unresolved acquisition blockers to be presented as structured user questions before downstream work continues.
changes: Added dataset-acquisition to the experiment skill routing table.
Required source, size, license, authentication, integrity, and minimal-read checks.
Required structured user choices for unrecoverable acquisition failures.
Prevented unresolved data blockers from being silently bypassed into Results or formal paper writing.

rollback.notes: Restore the prior generic data checkpoint without the dedicated acquisition skill.
